decisions.rationale: Not taste. GWTextField - the app's own component, used by Settings, Markets search, the account manager and onboarding across 7 files - renders labels this way. context_notes: Facts worth not re-deriving. (1) theme.dart:242 sets an app-wide focusedBorder, and a PER-STATE border always beats InputDecoration's `border` fallback - that is why 'borderless' fields grew a blue box on focus; any field claiming to be borderless must silence all four states. (2) A BoxDecoration carrying a border INSETS its child by the border width, so animating from no-border to border makes content twitch - keep the border present and transparent instead. (3) A Stack gives non-positioned children LOOSE constraints, so a Text inside one shrink-wraps and textAlign:center does nothing. (4) Hot reload is `kill -USR1 42347`; SIGUSR2 and `R` are a RESTART and crash the app on the RocksDB lock. Proof a reload landed: a fresh app.dill.incremental.dill under /var/folders/.../flutter_tools.d6tXkT/. (5) Chrome for Testing EXISTS at ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1228/ so sketches can be rendered headless; an earlier session wrongly reported no Chrome because it only checked /Applications. (6) swap_screen.dart:243 writes `fees: fromAmount` and transaction_displays.dart:474 renders it as 'Network Fee' - the swap detail drawer shows a wrong number TODAY; todo filed. (7) Swap history is real and persisted, but swap_screen.dart:227 is still `// TODO: invoke Squid API`, so every record describes a swap that never happened.
